statusText: Mapped policy state: EA_ON. Tail is below the blocking threshold while Stress remains extreme.
recommendation: Current policy mapping is EA_ON; extreme Stress remains concentrated in the post-payroll and cash-session repricing window.
headline: Post-payroll whipsaw keeps Tail low despite extreme Stress
body: August payrolls materially exceeded expectations and pushed Treasury yields higher, but observed delayed NQ price discovery after the release and cash open has been strongly two-sided, with a large session retracement and rebound rather than persistent mean-reversion failure. Gulf supply disruption keeps background Stress extreme.

lookbackSummary: Tail was elevated during Thursday's U.S. afternoon trend-up phase, then declined through the overnight session. It returned to WATCH as Friday's payroll event approached and remained at 24 through the release hour, while Stress stayed extreme.
outlookSummary: Observed post-payroll price discovery is two-sided enough to pull current Tail below WATCH despite extreme macro Stress. Tail may briefly return to WATCH during the remaining cash-session danger window or power hour if directional efficiency rebuilds; otherwise the forecast decays toward low Tail into the weekend while headline-gap Stress remains high.

forecast.analysis: Observed delayed NQ spans 29,503.25–29,704.50 and rebounded near 29,606.75 after payrolls. The large retracement and recovery show two-sided price discovery, not persistent mean-reversion failure.
